summary: A commercial fund established in 2005 supporting the growth of the Danish maritime sector through financial support for innovation projects, entrepreneurship, maritime business development, academic research, and maritime education. It focuses on high-risk, forward-looking initiatives in digitization, automation, green transition, and research with the aim to create jobs and develop the Danish maritime industry.
eligible_applicants: Companies with significant activities in Denmark
Institutions with significant activities in Denmark
Individuals with significant activities in Denmark

Applicants with attachment to or strong interest in the Danish maritime industry, including shipping, shipbuilding, ancillary industries, service companies, research and education institutions, service organisations, and public authorities

deadlines.application_deadline: Four times a year (quarterly board meetings)

reporting_requirements: Information on project progress as per grant agreement
Requirement to demonstrate use of funds in accordance with stated purpose
Submission of financial and activity reports upon project completion or as requested
